title: Home Page Load and Content Verification
description: Verify that the Home page loads successfully with all main sections: hero, process explanation, features overview, integrations, and testimonials, displaying correct content and images.

steps.description: Navigate to the Home page
Verify hero section is displayed with correct headline, background image or animation
Verify process explanation section shows all four steps: Commercial, Residential, Solar, and MEP
Check features overview section lists key smart building features properly
Validate integrations section displays expected integration logos and info
Check testimonials section loads client feedback with rating stars and text

title: Navigation Links Functionality and Routing
description: Ensure all navigation links in header and footer lead to correct pages and load content properly on both desktop and mobile viewports.

steps.description: Open the website on desktop viewport
Click each link in the header navigation one by one: Home, Commercial, Residential, Solar, Solutions
Verify corresponding page loads with expected content for each navigation link
Scroll to footer and click social icons and company links
Validate external/social links open correctly; internal links load pages without error
Resize browser to mobile viewport or use mobile device
Open mobile navigation menu
Repeat navigation link clicking and validation steps on mobile

title: Solar Solutions Page Content and Video Hero Validation
description: Validate that the Solar solutions page loads with background video hero, feature cards, and GSAP-powered stacked sections functioning as expected with correct content.

steps.description: Navigate to the Solar solutions page
Verify background video in hero section plays correctly without errors
Check all feature cards are displayed with correct text and images
Scroll through GSAP stacked sections and verify smooth animations and transitions
Confirm page content matches PRD-provided text and images

title: Solar Panels Product Page Verification
description: Verify the Solar Panels product page loads correctly with hero section, why-choose section, and panel types cards displaying accurate content.

steps.description: Navigate to the Solar Panels product page
Verify hero section is displayed with correct heading and visual elements
Check why-choose section content and images are accurate and visible
Validate panel types cards show correct product details and images

title: Solar Inverters Page Content and Image Verification
description: Confirm the Solar Inverters page loads an inverter options grid with all images sourced from public assets and that CTAs are correctly removed per customization.

steps.description: Navigate to the Solar Inverters page
Verify the inverter options grid is present and all images load without broken links
Ensure that no call-to-action buttons are present as per customization

title: Solar Battery Page and Benefit Grid Verification
description: Validate the Solar Battery page displays battery storage benefits in a grid format with custom images from the public directory and confirms no displayed CTA buttons.

steps.description: Navigate to the Solar Battery page
Check battery storage benefits grid is visible with accurate text and images
Verify no call-to-action buttons are shown on this page

title: Commercial and Residential Pages Static Content Validation
description: Verify the static Commercial and Residential pages under /app display correct simple layout and content as specified in the PRD.

steps.description: Navigate to the Commercial page
Verify page loads with correct heading and key content as per PRD
Navigate to the Residential page
Verify page loads with proper heading and correct text content

title: Success Stories Section Data and Display Check
description: Verify the Success Stories section properly displays key projects with locations, automation types, images, and described outcomes matching the PRD content.

steps.description: Access the Success Stories page or section
Verify all listed projects show accurate location and automation details
Check that corresponding images for projects load correctly
Confirm textual success descriptions align with PRD text

title: Customer Testimonials Display and Content Accuracy
description: Ensure customer testimonials are displayed with real client feedback, proper ratings, images, and matching PRD content, providing trust signals.

steps.description: Navigate to the Testimonials section or page
Confirm each testimonial includes client name, image, rating stars, and feedback text
Check testimonial content matches provided PRD data

title: Responsive Header and Footer Layout and Functionality
description: Validate the header and footer render consistently with correct branding and navigation links, social icons with effects, and function properly on both desktop and mobile devices.

steps.description: Load website on desktop and mobile viewports
Verify header shows navigation links with proper layout and branding on desktop
Open mobile menu and check header navigation links appear and are clickable
Verify footer displays social icons with glow effects and company info on all devices
Check all links in header and footer are functional and lead to correct destinations

title: Responsive Design and Layout Across Device Sizes
description: Verify that pages and UI components adapt correctly and remain usable on various screen sizes, including small mobile phones, tablets, and large desktop monitors.

steps.description: Open website on a range of device viewport sizes from mobile phone to desktop
Check layout adapts without horizontal scroll or content overlap
Validate font sizes, images, buttons, and navigation remain accessible and visually consistent

title: Animation and Interactive UI Elements Smooth Performance
description: Ensure all animations powered by Framer Motion, GSAP, and other UI interactions load smoothly without visual glitches or performance issues.

steps.description: Navigate through pages containing animations (Home, Solar page, etc.)
Observe that animations trigger correctly and run smoothly without stuttering
Verify interactive components respond promptly to user input without errors

title: API Route /api/tanti-media Responsiveness and Data Integrity
description: Test the API route for Tanti media listing to ensure it returns correct data and handles errors gracefully.

steps.description: Send a GET request to /api/tanti-media
Verify API returns 200 status with expected list of media items in correct format
Send malformed or unauthorized request if applicable
Confirm API responds with appropriate error code and message

title: Error Handling for Missing or Broken Media Assets
description: Check that the website gracefully handles missing or broken image and video assets without crashing or unhandled exceptions.

steps.description: Temporarily replace or remove media files referenced in components (hero images, background videos, testimonial photos)
Load affected pages
Verify placeholders or fallback UI appear without layout breaking
Confirm no fatal errors or crashes occur

title: Custom Scroll Restoration Logic Functionality
description: Validate that the custom scroll restoration logic on the Home page retains previous scroll positions correctly upon navigation and back actions.

steps.description: Scroll down on Home page to a mid-section
Navigate to another page, e.g., Solar page
Use browser back button to return to Home page
Verify the scroll position on Home page restores to previous location before navigation
